title: $N$-dimensional discrete Fourier transform via bosonic Hamiltonian
summary: The discrete Fourier transform (DFT) underpins many classical algorithms and is a fundamental unitary operator for quantum information processing. Implementing the $N$-dimensional DFT in photonic integrated circuits (PICs) is limited by the cascades of Mach-Zehnder interferometers that current architectures require. Here we propose bosonic Hamiltonians that realize the $N$-dimensional DFT through a single stage of multimode evolution, complemented only by phase shifters before and after the interaction region, in a geometry suited to 3D waveguides.
